mintAuthority.summary: USDQ is issuer-minted on both Ethereum (3/5 multisig owner, no modules) and Polygon (2/5 multisig owner, no modules) via the same HadronToken onlyOwner mint function. Polygon can independently mint. Both chain proxy admins are 3/5 multisigs, no modules.

review.evidence: At ETH block 25294990: owner()=0x284Df (3/5 multisig, no modules), proxy admin=0xa6724f (3/5 multisig, no modules). At Polygon block 88323726: owner()=0x84e8d (2/5 multisig, no modules), proxy admin=0x2f875 (3/5 multisig, no modules). Polygon deployment uses same HadronToken implementation and can independently mint. XRPL and Algorand contracts not in mint-authority scope (separate ledger rails); Ethereum and Polygon are the material EVM mint surfaces. Quantoz publishes a real-time issuer-operated transparency dashboard, but challenge searches of its transparency, audit, assurance, and product materials found no recurring independent USDQ assets-and-liabilities report. No independent attestor, cadence, or latest qualifying report date is available, so reconciliation is unknown. The DNB register matches Quantoz Payments B.V. under relation R186418 as an authorized Electronic Money Institution, supporting prudential supervision of the same issuer entity. Economic-posture fields reviewed 2026-08-15: issuer-controlled direct mint and upgrades are unbounded, the ad-hoc self-reported snapshot does not establish recurring whole-supply reconciliation, and DNB authorizes Quantoz Payments B.V. as the USDQ MiCA EMT issuer. Wave 2 external research reviewed 2026-08-15: Quantoz's transparency page publishes a dated issuer snapshot covering all listed USDQ deployments and DNB supervision, but accessible evidence does not establish a recurring report series or live independently verifiable assets-and-liabilities reconciliation for the complete supply.
